messages.text:
Good morning. We're about 3 weeks into this and haven't seen
 anything pop up. Should I carefully dig one up to see if anything is
 happening? or give it more time?

 

 On 3/23/2025 9:20 PM, Lasclay wrote:

 

 
 
 
 
 Hello Kevin,

 

 

 Beach Haven is in USDA Zone 7b. Which means you can plant
 pretty much all of the species we offer without a problem.
 Hardiness zones are rated from cold to warm (2 is colder, 3 is
 warmer). If something is rated Zone 3, for example, it means
 this is the coldest zone it can survive in, but it will most
 likely survive in warmer zones, up to 6 zones higher.

 

 

 
 Warmly,

 __

 Gabriel 

 Co-founder 

 Lasclay

 On 3/23/2025 9:20 PM, Lasclay wrote:

 
 Hello Kevin,

 

 

 Beach Haven is in USDA Zone 7b.
 Which means you can plant pretty much
 all of the species we offer without a
 problem. Hardiness zones are rated
 from cold to warm (2 is colder, 3 is
 warmer). If something is rated Zone 3,
 for example, it means this is the
 coldest zone it can survive in, but it
 will most likely survive in warmer
 zones, up to 6 zones higher.

 

 

 
 Warmly,

 __

 Gabriel 

 Co-founder 

 Lasclay

messages.text:
Hi Kevin,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!
